comment: The tutorial as a public game reaches it: OPTIONS=tutorial skips allmain.c maybe_do_tutorial()'s query and do.c goto_level() makes tut-1 through mklev() -> makemaz() -> sp_lev.c load_special(), whose des.* calls run inside level creation. The hero reads the first engraving and walks three squares. Seed, date, character and inputs chosen independently.
